title: Voyage of the Gikumi - Fraser River boat tours in Steveston
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the stories of the historic Cannery Channel in Steveston, on a two-hour fully guided tour on board the MV Gikumi, a beautifully restored wooden vessel, known as BC's first whale-watching boat. Explore the natural beauty of the rich Fraser River estuary, and learn about the history, ecology and culture of this place that was once known as the salmon capital of the world.
